title: SceneDocument
description: Scene document in the CouchDB database 'scenes', format 1.0

_id.description: scene id, generated by CouchDB when omitted

schemaVersion.description: scene format the document complies with; documents without it are read as format 1.0

creationTime.description: creation time in milliseconds since the epoch; scenes without it are not listed by Koia

database.description: name of the CouchDB database that holds the entries of the scene

context.description: name/value pairs describing the origin of the data

name.description: column name, equal to the property name in the entries

dataType.description: Time values are milliseconds since the epoch, Object values are JSON strings

format.description: display format of Time values (e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss,SSS')

indexed.description: requires exactly one CouchDB index on this column in the entries database

config.title: SceneConfig
config.description: owned by Koia; writers of format 1.0 SHOULD write {"records":[],"views":[]}, the form accepted by every Koia deployment
